title: Shaving Electric Razor All-in-one Whole Body Washing And Shaving Machine
body_html:
Product information:

Product power: 5w
Voltage: 5v-USB charging
Charging time: 2 hours
Battery type: Lithium battery

 Features:

1. Brand-new body design, multi-functional five-in-one container, can shave, wash face, trim sideburns and trim nose hair, compact size, convenient and comfortable operation, it is also a home choice for people who shave their heads.
2. Touch the switch to feel the speed and comfort of digital products.
3. Use the universal USB power supply mode, suitable for USB chargers, and computer ports can be used universally.
4. Large-capacity lithium battery design, fast charging, long-lasting battery life.
5. Wet and dry design, can be used in the bathroom, and can also be used with beard cream.
6. The English version of the digital display settings, the use time is displayed when the machine is turned on, and the use time is displayed when the machine is turned off.
Charging instructions: When the product indicator can be used for 05S, the indicator flashes, indicating that the power is insufficient, and the battery needs to be refilled in time. The product is fully charged for 2 hours, and the digital display shows 90 to indicate that the battery is fully charged. 


Packing list:

1. Shaver*1
2. Dust cover*1
3. Nose hair cutter head*1
4. Cleansing brush head*1
5. Silicone brush head*1
6. Barber knife set*1
7. Cleaning brush*1
8. Lubricant *1
9.USB charging cable*1
